name: BrowserOS Marketplace
description: The official BrowserOS marketplace: sandboxed apps and adoptable specs.

items.name: Editor
items.description: A text editor with integrated AI agent for content manipulation

items.name: BMAD Method
items.description: BMAD's agile method as a spec-method pack: five personas (Mary, John, Sally, Winston, Amelia), a PRD-to-stories pipeline, and BOS-grounded architecture/UX/story workflows. Adapted from upstream 6.13.x.

items.name: gws-calendar
items.description: Google Calendar: Manage calendars and events.

items.name: gws-calendar-agenda
items.description: Google Calendar: Show upcoming events across all calendars.

items.name: gws-calendar-insert
items.description: Google Calendar: Create a new event.

items.name: gws-docs
items.description: Read and write Google Docs.

items.name: gws-docs-write
items.description: Google Docs: Append text to a document.

items.name: gws-drive
items.description: Google Drive: Manage files, folders, and shared drives.

items.name: gws-drive-upload
items.description: Google Drive: Upload a file with automatic metadata.

items.name: gws-gmail
items.description: Gmail: Send, read, and manage email.

items.name: gws-gmail-forward
items.description: Gmail: Forward a message to new recipients.

items.name: gws-gmail-read
items.description: Gmail: Read a message and extract its body or headers.

items.name: gws-gmail-reply
items.description: Gmail: Reply to a message (handles threading automatically).

items.name: gws-gmail-reply-all
items.description: Gmail: Reply-all to a message (handles threading automatically).

items.name: gws-gmail-send
items.description: Gmail: Send an email.

items.name: gws-gmail-triage
items.description: Gmail: Show unread inbox summary (sender, subject, date).

items.name: gws-gmail-watch
items.description: Gmail: Watch for new emails and stream them as NDJSON.

items.name: gws-shared
items.description: gws CLI: Shared patterns for authentication, global flags, and output formatting.

items.name: gws-sheets
items.description: Google Sheets: Read and write spreadsheets.

items.name: gws-sheets-append
items.description: Google Sheets: Append a row to a spreadsheet.

items.name: gws-sheets-read
items.description: Google Sheets: Read values from a spreadsheet.

items.name: Knowledge Base
items.description: Create and manage knowledge bases (uploaded documents, Google Drive folders, websites); ingests content into a Graphiti knowledge graph and exposes kb_search/kb_retrieve tools to agents over MCP.

items.name: Live Avatar
items.description: Lip-synced talking avatar (AVTR-1) — a voice engine with a face. Streams TTS audio to an avatar rendering server; BOS shows the result in the presence window. Not a separate app.

items.name: Lunar Lander the classic game
items.description: Land a lunar lander on the moon

items.name: OKF Knowledge Base
items.description: Durable, human-readable knowledge base stored as OKF bundles (Markdown + YAML frontmatter). Exposes okf_* tools natively to the BOS assistant and a REST bridge for its config UI.

items.name: OpenSpec
items.description: OpenSpec as a BOS method pack — the lightweight, brownfield-first alternative to spec-kit. Named changes, a specs tree that grows by archiving, and artifacts whose dependencies are enablers, not gates.

items.name: recipe-save-email-attachments
items.description: Find Gmail messages with attachments and save them to a Google Drive folder.

items.name: recipe-save-email-to-doc
items.description: Save a Gmail message body into a Google Doc for archival or reference.

items.name: Terminal Service
items.description: WebSocket-based shell daemon — the reference/example service for user-specs/002-service-daemons, bundled with its own Terminal app under app/.

items.name: WebDAV VFS Mount
items.description: Expose your BrowserOS VFS over WebDAV for native mount support (Windows, macOS Finder, Linux davfs2).

items.name: Workflow Manager
items.description: Service-owned workflow engine: node model (agent source x output type), structured branch routing with Option A selection propagation, parallel scheduling with per-step/per-run timeouts, a live per-step run state (status/attempt/current action/per-sub-agent fan-out/agent trace) served to both the tools and the app, dry-run fixtures, persistence to the real VFS, and 039-compliant service-declared tools (workflow_list/create/read/modify/run/status/cancel/delete/export/validate/run_list/run_get).
